title: New site, same fire
author: Burnt Out Games
summary: We built burntoutgames.com properly. Here's what's on it, and what this devlog is going to be.
body:
The old site did its job. This one is built from our own brand guide, lives on our own domain, and we can update it ourselves in about thirty seconds.

## What's on it

Every game has a real page now. **EXO** has the most on it, because EXO is what we're deep in right now: what the speed actually does, how the chaining works, and the engine work that got us there.

There's a [team page](/studio/) too, which is the one we're happiest about. Ten of us, plus everyone who jumped on EXO.

## What this devlog is for

The stuff we're excited about that doesn't fit in thirty seconds. Systems we're proud of, things we worked out along the way, and the occasional accident that turned into a feature.

If you want the fast version we're on [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@burnt_out_games) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/burntoutgames/). If you want to play EXO before it's done, [wishlist it on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4587490/EXO/) and keep an eye out for a playtest.

GLFH.
